svg.font-family: Inter, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: An app encrypting and decrypting through Dapr without ever holding the key
svg.desc: Along the top, two dashed areas side by side. The left, captioned Generic, holds three marked components: JWKS, Kubernetes secrets and Local storage. The right, captioned Clouds, holds Azure Key Vault, Google Key Management and AWS Secrets Manager. Below them, a green hexagon named App with an arrow to a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, labelled Encrypt and Decrypt API. The Dapr hexagon is named Dapr sidecar, with the line "Built-in cryptographic engine" under it, and a line with a head at each end rises from it and divides, one branch turning left and up into the generic components, the other right and up into the clouds.
